subject.title: bundle-mcp: remote streamable-http server connects but tools never materialize for a Pi agent (2026.5.7)

question: Is the v2026.6.11 sandbox/doctor evidence enough to close this streamable-http Pi-agent report, or should maintainers require a current-version retry of the reporter's exact setup first?
rationale: The code and docs now cover several likely causes, but the issue's reported config lacks the effective sandbox policy and no latest-release run proves whether the exact bearer-authenticated streamable-http case is fixed.

options.title: Request Current-Version Confirmation
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a v2026.6.11/current-main retry with doctor output, sandbox policy, and redacted compiled-tool evidence.

options.title: Close As Sandbox-Diagnostic Resolved
options.body: Close if maintainers are satisfied that the linked sandbox root cause fully explains this setup and the shipped doctor/docs path is the accepted fix.

options.title: Promote A Maintainer Repro
options.body: Have a maintainer reproduce with a remote streamable-http MCP server and decide from provider-bound tool evidence whether a new fix is needed.

recommendation.title: Request Current-Version Confirmation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a v2026.6.11/current-main retry with doctor output, sandbox policy, and redacted compiled-tool evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history puts this handle on both the current MCP runtime snapshot and the docs that describe the sandbox/MCP exposure contract.
